description: Defines the RetrieveAttributes class, which implements a command to retrieve all attributes of a specific Thing entity by its ID within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating command instances, parsing JSON input, and accessing command properties.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributes
classes.description: An immutable command class to retrieve all attributes of a specific Thing, supporting JSON serialization and deserialization, with methods to create and manipulate command instances.

methods.name: RetrieveAttributes of
methods.description: Creates a new RetrieveAttributes command instance given a ThingId and headers.

methods.name: RetrieveAttributes fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object or string into a RetrieveAttributes command instance.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the selected fields to retrieve.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the target Thing entity.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON resource path for attributes.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for the command based on schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.
